blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Motorists will see a mixed movement in oil prices Tuesday, Oct. 6, with gasoline and kerosene prices rising by P1.90 to P3.30 per liter, respectively, while diesel prices drop by P1.30 per liter. The possible price increases to continuing concerns over supply disruptions caused by the conflict in the Middle East, as well as China’s decision to suspend oil product exports to markets outside Hong Kong and Macau, raising fears of worsening global fuel shortages.
